clauses.title: CL-D107 records the review-only relaunch of a result that names no run
clauses.section: ## CL-D107 — A review-only gate result whose correlation names no run is relaunched once
requires: A designated output whose correlation has `baseOid` and `headOid` both 40 zeros and `contractInput` and `snapshotFingerprint` both 64 zeros names no run.
A correlation that names any real value, another run's result included, stays a refusal at once.
Exact autofix keeps CL-D51's terminal rule for any designated output byte; relaunching this result there, a second relaunch, or a weaker test than all four null values requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: The review-only reader relaunches a result that names no run
The CL-D107 tests replay PR #253 round 2
requires: Issue #254 a gate result whose correlation names no run is relaunched once, not BLOCKED
Issue #254 a second result that names no run stops BLOCKED after one relaunch
Issue #254 a mismatched correlation that names any real value is not relaunched
Issue #254 exact autofix relaunches a result that names no run once per run
Issue #254 exact autofix does not relaunch a mismatched correlation that names a real value

clauses.title: CL-D93 names the added relaunch
requires: CL-D107 later added a result whose correlation names no run (#254).
